notes: Full description: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs lines 163-164 have a comment that says '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z = 1_742_000_000 (approx). Use 1_741_996_800 exactly.' but 1_741_996_800 is 2025-03-15T00:00:00Z (verified: python3 calendar.timegm((2025,3,15,0,0,0,0,0,0)) = 1741996800). The actual constant SC081_200D_EPOCH = 1_773_532_800 is correct. The comment is wrong — it describes a different year. The code constant and the sc081_validity_cap() function doc comment are both correct. Fix: remove the incorrect inline comment at WebPkiProfile::policy() or correct it to read '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z = 1_773_532_800'. Severity: P3 (doc/comment bug; code is correct).
title: FINDING: WebPkiProfile comment has wrong 2025-03-15 epoch for SC-081
